name: skills-prd-document
description: /prd in Chat, across the meetings: a short requirements draft of the latest meeting's discussion as a Chat document (Problem, Goals, Requirements, Out of scope, Open questions), filled, from what was said; a short line in the chat.

transcript.text: Our field engineers lose signal in basements and plant rooms, so they can't log a job until they're back outside.
They write it on paper and type it up later, and half the time the photos never make it in.
So the must-have is logging a job with no signal and syncing it when they're back online.
Yes. Photos too, ideally, but the job log comes first.
And editing other people's jobs offline is out, too risky with conflicts.
Agreed. What I don't know is how long the app should keep jobs that never sync.
